scope: Connected original issues found or revisited in the reference source follow-ups; none silently resolved or published as an executable rule.

passages.assertion: Body IV.1.A.2: HIV/AIDS and direct complications excluded until expiry of 90 days continuous coverage.
Summary PED row: initial 30 days for indemnity and 90 days for benefit basis under HIV/AIDS.

issues.effect: Block unconditional HIV expense waiting-end conclusion; distinguish lump-sum waiting/termination/SI consequences.
issues.required_information: Benefit form, condition, clock and source assertions must stay distinct.

passages.assertion: Newborn benefit day-1 branches have maternal/scan, underwriting, intimation, endorsement and plan-specific conditions.
Midterm inclusion newborn starts day16 with proportionate premium, inclusion-date waits and underwriter approval.

issues.effect: Do not conflate ordinary paid member inclusion with the conditional newborn benefit or infer retrospective cover. This is not automatically classified as an irreconcilable contradiction.
issues.required_information: Separate benefit-specific newborn route from member-addition transaction.

passages.assertion: Individual/Non-Floater heading contains Family Floater text listing parents and parents-in-law.
Family Floater definition lists self, spouse/live-in and up to three dependent children.

issues.effect: Child-count alternative does not establish parents in a floater; preserve conflicting heading/body scope.
issues.required_information: Attach assertions to their actual section headings and conflicting scope.

passages.assertion: Section C pharmacy says cashless only; section VI mentions pharmacy reimbursement co-pay.
Utilisation modes include pharmacy reimbursement under stated absent-network/emergency conditions.

issues.effect: Do not promise pharmacy reimbursement or silently select a preferred mode. Wallet adjustment wording also needs clarification before calculating a balance.
issues.required_information: Separate benefit grant, mode, provider exception, co-pay and wallet event.
